summary: In ansible-core (Ansible 9.1.0), nested templating in assert can prevent the conditional from being evaluated.
questions: Why does my assert with {{ }} fail after upgrading to Ansible 9.1?
Is nested templating in assert still allowed?

answer_card.title: assert fails with nested templating
answer_card.answer_md: Since Ansible 9.1.0, `assert` conditions containing **nested templates** (`{{ }}` inside `that:`) may fail to evaluate. Write conditions as plain Jinja expressions, e.g. `that: result.stdout == 'ok'`.
